tools.name: screen_point_at
tools.description:
Point at something on the screen the user is sharing with the call: draws a ring around it, with a short caption beside it. Replaces whatever is currently drawn.

Name what to point at with `target` and it is found on the surface itself, at exactly the right place: "color balance", "the Send button", "the search field". Prefer this always. If the name is not on the surface you are told what is, so you can point again or say it out loud.

Give `x`/`y`/`width`/`height` only for something with no label to find it by — a region of an image, a spot on a canvas, a plugin's own drawing. They are fractions of the shared surface, 0 to 1, measured against the picture you were last shown, and they are a guess at where the thing is rather than a reading of it.

Requires the user to be sharing their screen. If nothing is shared this fails, and the right move is to ask them to share before pointing again.

marks.description: What to point at now, replacing whatever is on screen. Point at one thing at a time unless a step genuinely needs more.

items.description: One thing to point at: either `target` naming it, or bounds giving its rectangle. Naming is exact; bounds are estimated, so name it whenever it has a name.

target.description: What to point at, in words: the label on the control, or a phrase containing it ("the stabilization button"). Found on the surface itself, so it lands exactly. Leave out only when the thing has no label.

x.description: Left edge as a fraction of the shared surface's width (0 to 1). Only for something `target` cannot name.

y.description: Top edge as a fraction of the shared surface's height (0 to 1). Only for something `target` cannot name.

width.description: Width, as a fraction of the surface's width.

height.description: Height, as a fraction of the surface's height.

caption.description: A short imperative for what to do with it, e.g. "Click Share". Say the rest out loud.

target_client_id.description: ID of the specific client to target. Required when multiple clients support host_cu; omit when only one is connected.

tools.name: screen_clear_marks
tools.description: Take down whatever is drawn on the user's shared screen. Use it when the step is done, when the user has moved on, or when the conversation has left the screen behind. Marks come down on their own when the share ends or moves to another surface.

target_client_id.description: ID of the specific client to target. Required when multiple clients support host_cu; omit when only one is connected.
